podcast.body: This "contemplative ethereal" track was the Billboard year-end number one for 2018, topping the Hot 100 for 11 weeks. Drake dominated that year, with multiple number one singles. While the song was described as "droning and broody" at the time, its unique sound influenced many subsequent hits, showcasing Drake's trendsetting capabilities. "Drake's biggest of the year was the contemplative ethereal God's plan which topped the hot 100 for 11 weeks."
